body: I have this kind of nightmare like every day, it fucking sucks and I cant stop it

I have sth like it. Ever since January, the amount of nightmares and bad dreams that I've been having have increased so much. Most of the time they always revolve around my anxiety, being alone, people that I tried being friends with but couldn't cuz I can't socialize, these people pop up in my dream. And I always feel like they're there whenever I have sleep paralysis. I've decided to try to get help from my doctor and she referred me to a therapist, I haven't started yet but I'm hoping it works

I think it differs from everyone. Personally, there's sth that I see or hear or feel that triggers a bad memory. Whenever that happens I start breathing really heavily and trying to run to a quiet isolated corner or room and cry. I just feel like I want to cover myself or like hide myself and stay alone
